collections.description: 从图文表征和视觉语言连接，逐步学习指令训练、多模态位置编码与统一生成。
collections.description_en: Progress from image-text representations and vision-language connections to instruction tuning, multimodal positions, and unified generation.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.summary: 图文双编码器、对称对比损失与零样本分类。
papers.summary_en: Dual image and text encoders use a symmetric contrastive loss for transferable representations and zero-shot classification.

papers.title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
papers.summary: 用大规模含噪图文配对训练双编码器，比较数据规模与清洗方式。
papers.summary_en: Train dual encoders on large-scale noisy image-text pairs to study the roles of data scale and filtering.

papers.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
papers.summary: 逐图文对 sigmoid 目标及其归约尺度。
papers.summary_en: Optimize independent sigmoid objectives for image-text pairs with the correct loss reduction scale.

papers.title: SigLIP 2: Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders with Improved Semantic Understanding, Localization, and Dense Features
papers.summary: 将描述生成、自蒸馏、掩码预测和在线数据筛选纳入表征学习。
papers.summary_en: Combine captioning, self-distillation, masked prediction, and online data curation to improve visual representations.

papers.title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
papers.summary: 用生成与过滤改善图文监督，同时支持理解与生成。
papers.summary_en: Improve image-text supervision through caption generation and filtering while supporting both understanding and generation.

papers.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
papers.summary: 用 Q-Former 连接冻结视觉编码器和语言模型；适合练习查询 token 与跨注意力。
papers.summary_en: Connect frozen image encoders and language models with a Q-Former, exposing query tokens and cross-attention as exercise components.

papers.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
papers.summary: 连接预训练视觉与语言模型，处理交错图文和少样本上下文。
papers.summary_en: Connect pretrained vision and language models to handle interleaved image-text inputs and few-shot context.

papers.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
papers.summary: 视觉编码器与语言模型连接，并用视觉指令数据训练。
papers.summary_en: Connect a vision encoder to a language model and train the combined model on visual instruction data.

papers.title: InstructBLIP: Towards General-purpose Vision-Language Models with Instruction Tuning
papers.summary: 让视觉特征提取依赖指令，比较指令感知与固定特征查询。
papers.summary_en: Condition visual feature extraction on instructions to compare instruction-aware queries with fixed feature queries.

stages.title: 多模态位置、音视频与统一生成
stages.title_en: Multimodal positions, audio-video, and unified generation

papers.title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
papers.summary: 以图像配对为桥梁，将文本、音频、深度、热成像、IMU 等模态对齐。
papers.summary_en: Use image-paired data to align text, audio, depth, thermal images, and IMU signals in one embedding space.

papers.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
papers.summary: 将图像与文本 token 提前融合，统一理解与混合模态生成。
papers.summary_en: Fuse image and text tokens early to support unified understanding and mixed-modal generation.

papers.title: Qwen2-VL: Enhancing Vision-Language Model's Perception of the World at Any Resolution
papers.summary: 动态分辨率与多模态 RoPE；适合抽取时间、高度、宽度位置编码练习。
papers.summary_en: Use dynamic resolution and multimodal RoPE, with temporal, height, and width positions as exercise components.

papers.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
papers.summary: 原生动态分辨率视觉编码、窗口注意力与视频绝对时间定位。
papers.summary_en: Combine native dynamic-resolution visual encoding, window attention, and absolute temporal localization in video.

papers.title: InternVL3: Exploring Advanced Training and Test-Time Recipes for Open-Source Multimodal Models
papers.summary: 原生多模态预训练、可变视觉位置编码与偏好优化。
papers.summary_en: Study native multimodal pretraining, variable visual positional encoding, and preference optimization.

papers.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
papers.summary: 交错 MRoPE、多层视觉特征注入和文本时间戳对齐。
papers.summary_en: Combine interleaved MRoPE, multilevel visual feature injection, and text-based timestamp alignment.

papers.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
papers.summary: Thinker–Talker 架构、音视频时间对齐和流式语音输出。
papers.summary_en: Use a Thinker–Talker architecture for temporally aligned audio-video understanding and streaming speech output.

collections.description: 从模仿学习和动作块出发，串联动作扩散、通用机器人策略、世界模型与可微动作模仿。
collections.description_en: Connect imitation learning and action chunks with action diffusion, generalist robot policies, world models, and differentiable motion imitation.

papers.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
papers.summary: 在当前策略访问的状态上收集专家动作并聚合数据，处理分布偏移。
papers.summary_en: Aggregate expert actions at states visited by the current policy to address distribution shift.

papers.title: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
papers.summary: Transformer 与条件 VAE 预测动作块；可练动作块重叠执行和时间集成。
papers.summary_en: Predict action chunks with a Transformer and conditional VAE, with overlapping execution and temporal ensembling as exercise components.

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.summary: 条件动作扩散、去噪回归和滚动执行。
papers.summary_en: Learn conditional action diffusion through denoising regression and execute actions with a receding horizon.

papers.title: RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.summary: 统一具有物理意义的动作空间，用扩散 Transformer 学习双臂动作。
papers.summary_en: Unify physically meaningful action spaces and use a diffusion Transformer to learn bimanual actions.

papers.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
papers.summary: 语言条件视觉 token 输入与离散动作预测。
papers.summary_en: Predict discrete actions from language-conditioned visual tokens.

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.summary: 把动作表示为文本 token，联合视觉语言任务与机器人轨迹训练。
papers.summary_en: Represent actions as text tokens and jointly train on vision-language tasks and robot trajectories.

papers.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
papers.summary: Transformer 加扩散动作解码器，支持不同观测与动作空间的适配。
papers.summary_en: Combine a Transformer with a diffusion action decoder to adapt across observation and action spaces.

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.summary: 视觉语言表征到动作 token，适合练习动作离散化和反归一化。
papers.summary_en: Map vision-language representations to action tokens, with action discretization and unnormalization as exercise components.

papers.title: π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
papers.summary: 在 VLM 上增加通过 flow matching 生成连续动作块的动作专家。
papers.summary_en: Add a flow-matching action expert to a vision-language model to generate continuous action chunks.

papers.title: π₀.₅: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
papers.summary: 联合高层语义任务与低层动作学习，扩展开放环境泛化。
papers.summary_en: Jointly learn high-level semantic tasks and low-level actions to improve generalization in open environments.

papers.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
papers.summary: 在潜在世界模型的想象轨迹上学习策略，使用跨任务稳定化机制。
papers.summary_en: Learn policies from imagined trajectories in a latent world model using stabilization mechanisms that transfer across tasks.

papers.title: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
papers.summary: 将世界模型学习和想象策略训练用于真实机器人在线交互。
papers.summary_en: Apply world-model learning and imagined policy training to online interaction with physical robots.

papers.title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
papers.summary: 在潜在世界模型内进行局部轨迹优化，结合模型预测和价值估计。
papers.summary_en: Optimize local trajectories inside a latent world model by combining model predictions with value estimates.

papers.title: DeepMimic: Example-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning of Physics-Based Character Skills
papers.summary: 结合动作模仿与任务奖励学习物理角色控制。
papers.summary_en: Learn physics-based character control by combining motion imitation with task rewards.

papers.title: DiffMimic: Efficient Motion Mimicking with Differentiable Physics
papers.summary: 通过可微物理对状态匹配损失反传，并用示范回放稳定长时域优化。
papers.summary_en: Backpropagate state-matching losses through differentiable physics and stabilize long-horizon optimization with demonstration replay.

papers.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
papers.summary: 共享可微世界模型与短时域 BPTT；已有软生存回报和 critic 目标练习。
papers.summary_en: Use one differentiable world model with short-horizon BPTT; existing exercises cover soft-survival returns and critic targets.

collections.description: 围绕大模型的训练与部署，学习并行和状态分片、注意力与 KV 内存、推理调度及量化。
collections.description_en: Study large-model training and deployment through parallelism and state sharding, attention and KV memory, inference scheduling, and quantization.

papers.title: GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism
papers.summary: 按层分配设备，拆分 microbatch，以流水线和梯度累积训练大模型。
papers.summary_en: Partition layers across devices and split batches into microbatches for pipelined execution with gradient accumulation.

papers.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
papers.summary: 将注意力和 MLP 的矩阵运算分布到多个设备；可练列／行并行线性层。
papers.summary_en: Distribute attention and MLP matrix operations across devices, with column- and row-parallel linear layers as exercise components.

papers.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
papers.summary: 分片优化器状态、梯度和参数，逐步消除数据并行副本的冗余。
papers.summary_en: Shard optimizer states, gradients, and parameters to progressively remove redundancy across data-parallel replicas.

stages.title: 注意力与 KV 内存

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.summary: 分块与在线 softmax，避免存储完整注意力矩阵并减少显存访问。
papers.summary_en: Use tiling and online softmax to avoid storing the full attention matrix and reduce GPU memory accesses.

papers.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
papers.summary: 优化线程块和 warp 工作划分，减少非矩阵乘运算与通信。
papers.summary_en: Improve thread-block and warp work partitioning while reducing non-matmul operations and communication.

papers.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
papers.summary: 多组 query heads 共享较少的 KV heads，减少推理缓存容量。
papers.summary_en: Share fewer key-value heads among groups of query heads to reduce inference cache memory.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.summary: 使用块表映射非连续 KV 缓存，支持块共享并减少碎片浪费。
papers.summary_en: Map noncontiguous KV cache blocks through block tables to support sharing and reduce fragmentation.

papers.title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
papers.summary: 按生成迭代调度，让请求动态加入和离开批次。
papers.summary_en: Schedule at generation-iteration granularity so requests can dynamically join and leave batches.

papers.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
papers.summary: RadixAttention 复用前缀 KV 缓存，并优化结构化解码。
papers.summary_en: Use RadixAttention to reuse prefix KV caches and optimize structured decoding.

papers.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
papers.summary: 将 prefill 分块并与 decode 混合调度，降低长 prompt 对逐 token 延迟的干扰。
papers.summary_en: Mix chunked prefill with decode scheduling to reduce the impact of long prompts on per-token latency.

papers.title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
papers.summary: 分离 prefill/decode 的资源与并行配置，在延迟约束下优化有效吞吐。
papers.summary_en: Separate prefill and decode resources and parallelism settings to optimize goodput under latency constraints.

papers.title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
papers.summary: 利用近似二阶信息与误差补偿完成低比特训练后量化。
papers.summary_en: Use approximate second-order information and error compensation for low-bit post-training quantization.

papers.title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.summary: 逐通道等价缩放，把激活离群值的量化难度迁移到权重。
papers.summary_en: Apply equivalent per-channel scaling to shift the quantization difficulty of activation outliers into weights.

papers.title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
papers.summary: 根据激活统计选择重要通道，通过等价缩放保护低比特权重量化精度。
papers.summary_en: Use activation statistics to identify important channels and equivalent scaling to protect low-bit weight quantization accuracy.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.summary: 在冻结的 4-bit 基座上训练 LoRA，并用 NF4、双重量化和分页优化器节省显存。
papers.summary_en: Train LoRA adapters on a frozen 4-bit base model, using NF4, double quantization, and paged optimizers to save memory.

papers.title: SVDQuant: Absorbing Outliers by Low-Rank Components for 4-Bit Diffusion Models
papers.summary: 高精度低秩分支吸收离群值，残差使用 4-bit 量化。
papers.summary_en: Absorb outliers in a high-precision low-rank branch and quantize the residual to 4 bits.

collections.description: 从奖励和偏好监督出发，学习扩散策略梯度、可微奖励反传、随机 Flow 策略及高效更新。
collections.description_en: Start with reward and preference supervision, then study diffusion policy gradients, differentiable reward backpropagation, stochastic flow policies, and efficient updates.

papers.title: ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.summary: 从人类偏好学习奖励模型，再用 ReFL 将奖励反馈给生成器。
papers.summary_en: Learn a reward model from human preferences, then use ReFL to feed reward signals back to the generator.

papers.title: Diffusion Model Alignment Using Direct Preference Optimization
papers.summary: 通过相对参考模型的去噪误差差值优化偏好。
papers.summary_en: Optimize preferences through differences in denoising errors relative to a reference model.

papers.title: Aligning Diffusion Models by Optimizing Human Utility
papers.summary: 从单张图像的喜欢／不喜欢反馈优化效用，不要求成对偏好。
papers.summary_en: Optimize utility from likes and dislikes on individual images without requiring paired preferences.

papers.title: Using Human Feedback to Fine-tune Diffusion Models without Any Reward Model
papers.summary: 用直接偏好优化更新去噪策略，省去显式奖励模型。
papers.summary_en: Apply direct preference optimization to the denoising policy without training an explicit reward model.

papers.title: PC-Flow: Preference Alignment in Flow Matching via Classifier
papers.summary: 使用轻量偏好分类器引导 flow 分布，无需参考模型。
papers.summary_en: Guide the flow distribution with a lightweight preference classifier without a reference model.

papers.title: Training Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: 将去噪链视为多步决策过程，优化轨迹概率与终点奖励。
papers.summary_en: Treat the denoising chain as a multistep decision process and optimize trajectory probabilities using terminal rewards.

papers.title: DPOK: Reinforcement Learning for Fine-tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.summary: 在线策略优化结合 KL 正则，控制奖励提升和参考策略偏移。
papers.summary_en: Combine online policy optimization with KL regularization to balance reward improvement and drift from the reference policy.

papers.title: Aligning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Reward Backpropagation
papers.summary: 将可微奖励反传穿过生成过程，使用 LoRA 与梯度检查点控制内存。
papers.summary_en: Backpropagate differentiable rewards through generation while using LoRA and gradient checkpointing to manage memory.

papers.title: Directly Fine-Tuning Diffusion Models on Differentiable Rewards
papers.summary: 可微奖励直接反传、末尾 K 步截断与低方差梯度估计。
papers.summary_en: Backpropagate differentiable rewards directly, with last-K-step truncation and low-variance gradient estimation.

papers.title: Flow-GRPO: Training Flow Matching Models via Online RL
papers.summary: ODE 到 SDE 的随机策略构造、组相对优势与截断更新。
papers.summary_en: Construct stochastic policies by converting an ODE to an SDE, then apply group-relative advantages and clipped updates.

papers.title: DanceGRPO: Unleashing GRPO on Visual Generation
papers.summary: 将 GRPO 统一应用于扩散、rectified flow、图像和视频任务。
papers.summary_en: Apply GRPO across diffusion and rectified-flow models for image and video generation.

papers.title: MixGRPO: Unlocking Flow-based GRPO Efficiency with Mixed ODE-SDE
papers.summary: 窗口内使用 SDE 与 GRPO，窗口外使用 ODE，减少训练开销。
papers.summary_en: Use SDE sampling and GRPO within a window and ODE sampling outside it to reduce training overhead.

papers.title: DiffusionNFT: Online Diffusion Reinforcement with Forward Process
papers.summary: 用正负样本的前向 flow-matching 目标进行策略改进。
papers.summary_en: Improve the policy with forward flow-matching objectives on positive and negative samples.

papers.title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
papers.summary: 利用高斯策略精确 KL 和非对称 divergence mask 约束更新。
papers.summary_en: Constrain updates with exact Gaussian-policy KL divergence and an asymmetric divergence mask.
